title: galium pumilum subsp. atlanticum
intro: Galium pumilum subsp. atlanticum, commonly known as the dwarf bedstraw, is a subspecies of plant in the bedstraw family, Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Galium pumilum subsp. atlanticum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and lower fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
